methods.name: handleChat
methods.javadoc: Process chat messages (broadcast back to clients) and commands (executes)

methods.name: handleClientCommand
methods.javadoc: Processes the client status updates: respawn attempt from player, opening statistics or achievements, or acquiring 'open inventory' achievement

methods.name: handleClientInformation
methods.javadoc: Updates serverside copy of client settings: language, render distance, chat visibility, chat colours, difficulty, and whether to show the cape

methods.name: handleContainerButtonClick
methods.javadoc: Enchants the item identified by the packet given some convoluted conditions (matching window, which should/shouldn't be in use?)

methods.name: handleContainerClick
methods.javadoc: Executes a container/inventory slot manipulation as indicated by the packet. Sends the serverside result if they didn't match the indicated result and prevents further manipulation by the player until he confirms that it has the same open container/inventory

methods.name: handleContainerClose
methods.javadoc: Processes the client closing windows (container)

methods.name: handleCustomCommandSuggestions
methods.javadoc: This method is only called for manual tab-completion (the {@link net.minecraft.commands.synchronization.SuggestionProviders#ASK_SERVER minecraft:ask_server} suggestion provider).

methods.name: handleCustomPayload
methods.javadoc: Synchronizes serverside and clientside book contents and signing

methods.name: handleInteract
methods.javadoc: Processes left and right clicks on entities

methods.name: handleKeepAlive
methods.javadoc: Updates a players' ping statistics

methods.name: handleMovePlayer
methods.javadoc: Processes clients perspective on player positioning and/or orientation

methods.name: handlePlayerAbilities
methods.javadoc: Processes a player starting/stopping flying

methods.name: handlePlayerAction
methods.javadoc: Processes the player initiating/stopping digging on a particular spot, as well as a player dropping items

methods.name: handlePlayerCommand
methods.javadoc: Processes a range of action-types: sneaking, sprinting, waking from sleep, opening the inventory or setting jump height of the horse the player is riding

methods.name: handlePlayerInput
methods.javadoc: Processes player movement input. Includes walking, strafing, jumping, and sneaking. Excludes riding and toggling flying/sprinting.

methods.name: handleSetCarriedItem
methods.javadoc: Updates which quickbar slot is selected

methods.name: handleSetCreativeModeSlot
methods.javadoc: Update the server with an ItemStack in a slot.

methods.name: handleUseItem
methods.javadoc: Called when a client is using an item while not pointing at a block, but simply using an item

fields.name: JUMP_STRENGTH

fields.name: MAX_HEALTH

fields.name: MOVEMENT_SPEED
